fusions.name: Wardbreaker Spike
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 28 damage, ignores the target's resistances and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Weighted Spike
fusions.desc: Throws a heavy spike that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Mail Under the Cloak
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Lined Scabbard
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 8% arcane resistance.
